title: Phone
items: Phone: browse your phone's files from the watch, over Bluetooth. Open it from the new Phone button on the home dial, or from Phone files in Syndesia on the watch
Tap a file on your phone to copy it to Download › From phone on the watch and open it: photos, music, videos and text open right in Arkheia
Needs Syndesia on both your phone and your watch. The first time, your phone asks you to turn on All files access for Syndesia

title: Crown controls
items: Video and music: the crown now skips through or changes the volume. Tap the crown button in the controls to switch; Arkheia remembers your choice
Volume shows as a ring up the left edge of the screen while you turn
The home dial reliably follows the crown now, every time you open the app or come back to it
On watches whose side buttons apps can use, a press plays or pauses a video

title: Labels and level liquid
items: The liquid now tilts the right way
Every button around the dial has its name under the icon, and the bubbles are a little bigger to fit it

title: Liquid
items: The middle of the home dial is now a liquid orb, like the app icon: it fills up as your storage does, waves gently, and stays level when you tilt your wrist
A slow glow turns behind the dial and takes on the colour of whatever you've picked
Select several files at once (the tick button in a folder) to copy, move, zip or delete them together
Zip files and folders, and unzip .zip files, right on the watch
Copying, moving, zipping and deleting show their progress as a ring round the edge of the screen
A tap you can feel when a long job finishes

title: Made for the round screen
items: A whole new look built for the round screen
Home is now a dial: shortcuts in a ring around the middle, turn the crown to move round it (with a tick you can feel), tap the middle to open
A storage ring round the edge of the screen, coloured by what's using the space
Folder names and captions curve along the edge of the watch
Files and folders get an action wheel around their preview, with a delete you confirm in the middle
Music plays on a spinning record with progress round the edge; turn the crown to scrub
Storage shows a big ring of your space; the tile gets a storage ring too

title: Photos, videos and the Files permission
items: Uses your watch's Files permission now, so Allow file access covers every file, not just photos and music
New photo viewer: swipe between every photo in the folder, turn the crown or double-tap to zoom, drag to look around
New video player: tap for controls, a progress ring around the screen, skip 10 seconds, turn the crown to scrub, double-tap to fill the screen
New Gallery: every photo and video in a folder as thumbnails

title: File access from Settings
items: File access is now one button: Allow file access opens the switch in your watch's own Settings
No switch on your watch? Allow photos, videos and music with the normal Allow pop-up instead
Removed the Wireless debugging setup, so the app is much smaller again

title: Arkheia on your watch
items: Browse every folder on your watch, with folders first and sorting by name, date, size or type
Open photos (turn the crown or double-tap to zoom), read text files and play music right on the watch
Copy, move, rename and delete files and folders, and make new folders by voice or keyboard
Storage: free space at a glance, what's using it by type, and your largest files
Search by name, pin folders to the home screen, and jump back to recent files
An Arkheia tile with free space and shortcuts into your files
